doc: Zone number of each row: floor(_earth_lat / 5).astype(int) (floor, then a truncating cast: non-negative here), so zones 0..13, the cap rows all in 13. No latitude sits within 1e-4 of a zone edge (a tie would depend on the last bit of degrees()), apart from exact 0 and the capped 65. A float32 latitude array (float32 arithmetic before the floor).
